点阵 Lattice

万物皆点集，交互即映射。
Everything here is a set of points. Every interaction is a map.

A design system for personal sites and WebGL pieces: formal mathematics, data, agent systems and games, each built up from its premises.

  • MOVE disturb the field
  • HOLD melt the points
  • LET GO recrystallise into the next set
